Derivation: Derived parameter. For each subject, consider WEIGHT rows with non-missing ADVS.AVAL and the baseline value on that WEIGHT row and ADVS.ADT after ADSL.TRTSDT. A row with missing ADVS.AVAL is not a candidate and does not break a sequence. Order candidate rows by ADVS.ADT, then ADVS.AVISITN, then ADVS.SRCSEQ. A candidate qualifies when ADVS.AVAL is less than 0.85 times the baseline value on that WEIGHT row. Find the first pair of consecutive candidate measurements that both qualify. Create at most one WTLS15DT row per subject, only when that pair exists. The event date is ADVS.ADT from the first measurement of the pair. Set AVAL to that date as a numeric SAS date, in days since 1960-01-01.
